nodes.label: HAG-35/27 report: integration steward 2, build health, debris, collisions
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej

nodes.label: Build gate: node --check 217/217, boot clean, 9/9 HTTP probes, vite build clean
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: Build health GREEN at HEAD eaae1d7 under concurrent committers: 46 controllers, 32 route files, 38 app.use mounts, 217 backend JS files; counts unchanged from 2026-10-17. The steward verified by real boot and HTTP probe and deleted nothing.

nodes.label: CollectPayment.jsx (conditional useState calls, rules-of-hooks bug)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: Four useState calls inside a conditional branch violate the Rules of Hooks and will throw or silently desync state after the first render that skips them — flagged as the most likely real user-facing bug; outside build-health scope.

nodes.label: Housekeeping.jsx (components defined inside render)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: Components defined inside render reset their state on every parent render — runtime-impacting eslint react-hooks finding.

nodes.label: Header.jsx (Date.now during render, impure)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: Date.now called during render is impure, so a timestamp can drift between renders in the same commit.

nodes.label: printKOT.js:42 require-in-ESM defect (still open)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: require used in an ESM module is not a parse error (so node --check and Vite both miss it); it throws at runtime the first time that code path prints. Owned by the HAG-26 print area.

nodes.label: .DS_Store files tracked by git (no .gitignore rule)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: 2 of 3 .DS_Store files are git-tracked and churn in every commit because there is no .gitignore rule; fixing tracked-status is a decision for 'god', not something the steward does unilaterally.

nodes.label: src/assets.zip (1.09 MB tracked, unreferenced binary)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: The one debris item with a real diff footprint: a 1.09 MB binary referenced by nothing in the frontend source; deletion needs an explicit yes/no.

nodes.label: Employee/payroll frontend wiring gap (zero frontend callers)
nodes.author: meredith-mvawxvej
nodes.rationale: Backend /api/employees and /api/payroll are fully tracked and mounted but have zero frontend callers, and /api/roles is called once from src/pages/Payroll.jsx; four payroll routes are reachable only by hand — an open decision item, possibly deliberate dead surface.
